def pattern(n: int) -> str:
    if n <= 0:
        return ""
    
    lines = []
    max_len = 0
    
    def get_digit_sequence(k: int) -> str:
        seq = ""
        current = 0
        while k > 0:
            digit = current % 10
            seq += str(digit)
            current += 1
            k -= 1
        return seq[::-1]
    
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        ascending = get_digit_sequence(i)
        descending = get_digit_sequence(i - 1)[::-1] if i > 1 else ""
        content = ascending + descending
        lines.append(content)
        if len(content) > max_len:
            max_len = len(content)
    
    for i in range(n - 1, 0, -1):
        ascending = get_digit_sequence(i)
        descending = ascending[:-1][::-1] if len(ascending) > 1 else ""
        content = ascending + descending
        lines.insert(i, content)
    
    padded_lines = [line.center(max_len) for line in lines]
    return "\n".join(padded_lines)
